summary: One agent works through a pull request's comments, every comment in a fix run has one of five words, and Fix, answer and accept work on many comments at once.

new.title: One fix run for the comments you pick
new.copy: Fix on one comment or on many starts one fix run: one agent in one copy of your branch, working through the comments in order and reporting each as it finishes.

new.title: Five words for comments in a fix run
new.copy: A comment in a fix run reads Working, Needs you, Ready, Couldn't fix or Done, in the list, on the Branch page, in Activity and in Needs you. A comment that is not in a fix run reads Open.

new.title: The agent asks only when it must
new.copy: The agent no longer asks permission to commit.

new.title: Launch panel where you clicked
new.copy: Fix opens its panel in the right column, in place of the thread: the comments it covers with a check to drop any, the model it runs on and an optional note.

new.title: Fix, answer, retry and accept in bulk
new.copy: With no run going, Fix 9 open comments checks every comment you can fix and opens the panel, and Cmd+A checks the same set.
